seo.title: Pablo Durán, Aikido teacher in Lisbon | Dojo da Luz
seo.description: The path of Pablo Durán, 5th Dan Aikikai and IPDJ coach: training at Dojo de la Roseraie, practice in Japan and teaching Aikido in Lisbon.

title: Pablo Durán
lead: A path shaped by daily practice, transmission and a commitment to teaching Aikido to adults and children.
credentials: 5th Dan Tokyo Aikikai · IPDJ sports coach · Professional instructor
photoAlt: Pablo Durán, Aikido teacher and founder of Dojo da Luz in Lisbon
biography: Pablo Durán began practising Aikido in December 2002 in Jaén under Jacinto Camacho. His interest in Seishiro Endo's work led him to international seminars and, in Toulouse, to Franck Noël, who became his principal teacher.

He moved to Toulouse in March 2009. For six and a half years he practised daily at Dojo de la Roseraie, including a period as an uchideshi. From 2011 he began covering classes for Franck Noël and other teachers during their travels and absences.
In 2015 he moved to Lisbon to teach professionally. In February 2016 he opened Dojo da Luz, offering regular classes for adults, children and teenagers.

milestones.title: Beginnings in Jaén
milestones.text: He starts Aikido with Jacinto Camacho and encounters the teaching of Seishiro Endo.

milestones.title: Dojo de la Roseraie
milestones.text: He lives in Toulouse, practises daily with Franck Noël and spends a period as an uchideshi.

milestones.title: First teaching responsibilities
milestones.text: He begins leading classes at Dojo de la Roseraie when its teachers are away.

milestones.title: Practice in Japan
milestones.text: He visits Saku Dojo and Tokyo Aikikai Hombu Dojo during a month-long study trip.

milestones.title: Teaching children
milestones.text: He works with the children's teacher and develops specific teaching methods for younger students.

milestones.title: Dojo da Luz
milestones.text: He opens a Lisbon dojo dedicated to regular Aikido teaching for adults and children.

formation: Alongside daily practice in Toulouse, he attended seminars with Franck Noël in France, Spain and elsewhere in Europe, and followed teachers connected to Seigo Yamaguchi's approach, including Seishiro Endo, Masatoshi Yasuno, Tsuruzo Miyamoto, Christian Tissier and Bernard Palmier.
He also attended écoles des cadres led by Franck Noël and Bernard Palmier, focusing on examining practice, building teaching sequences and adapting instruction to different audiences.
teaching: His experience combines intensive practice, pedagogical training and regular teaching.
At Dojo da Luz he teaches adults, children and teenagers, aiming to transmit what he received with clarity, attention and respect for each practitioner's pace.
His work remains connected to the international community through seminars and practice gatherings.
lineageIntro: Pablo Durán's teaching belongs to a pedagogical line connecting Dojo da Luz with Dojo de la Roseraie and Tokyo Aikikai.

lineage.name: Franck Noël
lineage.text: Founder of Dojo de la Roseraie in Toulouse and Pablo Durán's direct reference since 2009.

lineage.name: Seigo Yamaguchi
lineage.text: A central influence on Franck Noël and on many Japanese and European teachers.

lineage.name: Tokyo Aikikai
lineage.text: The institution responsible for Pablo Durán's Aikikai grade and the discipline's technical continuity.
